system.description: Once per scene, as your action, spend 1 Fabula Point to repeat the most recent action taken by another character this scene, paying all costs. Never: Quirks or anything derived from one, Champion/Villain uniques, Equipment actions, rituals/Projects/anything outside a conflict, or a Guise swap.
